Name: Leah Revised (CP)
Author: stanloona420
Description:
With this, my bachelorettes revised series is complete! Well, I still need to make a seasonal version for Leah but I might take a break from that for a bit to get started on some bachelors. But I have started on one of her other outfits already! ?

This is a content patcher mod with two optional downloads, one for vanilla Leah, and one directly inspired by ye olde [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/595]Black Leah [/url]mod by prettykiller.


Just download your version of choice, unzip it into your mods folder and you're good to go! ?[url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles/]✨[/url]
